title: Terminal
adminsOnly: Only admins can open the terminal.
off: The terminal is still switched off. You can switch it on in the settings under Integrations.

ended.idle: The terminal sat unused for 30 minutes and is closed now.
ended.signedOut: You were signed out, so the terminal is closed.
ended.denied: You are no longer an admin, so the terminal is closed.
ended.off: An admin switched the terminal off in the settings.
ended.stopping: The server is stopping, so the terminal is closed.
ended.lost: The connection to the server dropped.
